name: AI-Powered Wizart Visualizer WordPress Plugin: Provide a Personalized Showroom-Like Shopping Experience to Boost Sales of Home Improvement & Finishing Materials
author: Wizart Inc.

sections.description:
Deliver a showroom-style shopping experience online to engage customers and boost sales.

| Wizart Visualizer | Demo | Pricing | Use Cases |

How Wizart Room Visualizer works – See the app in action!

  • Install Wizart Visualizer on your website
  • Let shoppers upload photos of their rooms and choose products from your catalog
  • Show them vivid, realistic, AI-powered visualizations instantly
  • Watch your engagement, conversions, and sales KPIs soar

The types of products you can visualize

  • Wallpapers
  • Wall panels
  • Flooring
  • Paints
  • Tiles
  • Carpets
  • Rugs
  • Wall Art
  • Murals
  • Custom-made home decor products
  • Any other products upon your request

How Wizart Visualizer Fuels Business Growth

By delivering a truly personalized shopping experience, Wizart Visualizer transforms how customers interact with your products – driving measurable impact at every stage of the sales journey.

The Results:
– x5 increase in conversions
– x4 faster sales cycle
– 40% reduction in product returns
– 27% higher engagement rate

Wizart Visualizer WordPress Plugin allows you to install the Visualizer in a few clicks. Please note that the Visualizer usage is based on subscription payments. See our detailed pricing.

Features You’ll Love

Customization & Branding
Tailor colors, logos, and interface elements to perfectly match your brand identity.

Interactivity & Scaling
Let shoppers arrange rugs, murals, and art with intuitive drag, rotate, and scale controls.

Smart Search & Filtering
Simplify catalog browsing with advanced filters and AI-powered image search.

Shopping Cart Functionality
Drive conversions with built-in checkout features: pricing display, “Add to Cart” button, abandoned cart reminders, and more.

Catalog Synchronization
Automate updates with PIM API integration, ensuring your product data is always current.

Rich Content Tools
Enhance your PDPs with interactive content to increase engagement rate.

Analytics & Reports
Track Visualizer performance, gain insights into customer behavior, and refine your marketing with actionable data.

Check out success stories and get back for yours!
sections.faq:
Is there a free trial available?

Yes, we offer a complimentary trial period of at least 14 days.

Can I upload my own patterns? What if I don’t have all the images?

When you sign up, we’ll create your account in the Wizart Product Information Management (PIM) system, giving you full control to upload, manage, and remove your product data.

You can also request access to catalogs from manufacturers and suppliers already on Wizart, so their products can be added to your account without manual uploads.

Your PIM account supports an unlimited number of SKUs. And if you ever need help with data import, our support team is ready to assist.

What languages do you support?

We support over 15 languages, including English, French, Spanish, German, Polish, Arabic, Portuguese, and Turkish, and can add new ones upon request within 2–4 weeks, free of charge.

A feature I want is missing from Wizart. Is it possible to add it?

We constantly enhance Wizart to deliver a better user experience, releasing updates with new features. If you have an idea that could make personalized shopping with Wizart even better, we’ll gladly review it for inclusion in our development cycle.
